note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. One supplied datum is substituted on the record plate of the position: the value naming what occupies it. The old value is kept, unchanged, in the dock as 'was' (never struck); only the dependent state follows (card B slides into the position and pushes card A into the history pocket, where it stays visible). Both cards have the same size, stroke and ink; no rule, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. OMITTED brief fields: grounds, routes and outcomes — the inspection substitutes one datum only; the places are shown physically and named through the panel's rows.
